delta_definition: WMSE(model) - WMSE(Mean), paired on fold and condition; lower is better. Each row uses the Mean scores on that row's own perturbation keys.
figure_contract: Original-style panel. Historical eleven labels, colors, italics, title, xlabel, marker style, and annotation format unchanged. X limits locked to the historical eleven CI extent. Height still uses 0.42*n+1.2. New rows inserted by ascending mean difference. Python/matplotlib, 7.2 in, 160 dpi PNG plus PDF.

models_excluded.reason: K562 run is not finished, so there is no paired per-perturbation WMSE to add.

not_a_common_cohort_ranking: scFoundation-reduced has n=1801 (fixed 1802 minus NBAS only). GeneCompass-reduced has n=1660. Every other row has n=1802. Rows are comparable only with the Mean on the same keys, not as a ranking on one shared perturbation set. Other models were not recomputed on 1801 or 1660.

significance.test: two-sided one-sample t-test of paired model-minus-Mean differences
significance.old_adjusted_p_change: Historical raw p, t, mu, and CI are unchanged. Adjusted P is 19/11 of the previous eleven-comparison values, capped at 1. GEARS display changes from 0.126 to 0.218.
significance.display: original adjusted-P and signed-t code, unchanged

bootstrap.historical_rows: Copied from the previous original-style CSV. Not resampled, so the sequential RNG stream of the original eleven is untouched.
bootstrap.new_rows: Copied from each run's published forest/paired summary after the per-perturbation mean, paired t, and raw p matched. Those runs used 10,000 percentile resamples, seed 42, paired perturbations pooled across five folds.
